scenes.spoken: Would you let an AI agent touch your treasury? Neither would we.
scenes.display: Would you let an AI agent touch your treasury? Neither would we.

scenes.spoken: Public posts show what builders need. They can also hide poisoned instructions. So our rule is simple: agents propose. Humans approve.
scenes.display: Public posts show what builders need. They can also hide poisoned instructions. So our rule is simple: agents propose. Humans approve.

scenes.spoken: This is AutoNEAR. It collects evidence, scores every opportunity in the open, and prepares one allowed action: a testnet deployment with a spend cap of zero. A human must approve it.
scenes.display: This is AutoNEAR. It collects evidence, scores every opportunity in the open, and prepares one allowed action: a testnet deployment with a spend cap of zero. A human must approve it.

scenes.spoken: Live snapshot: three hundred and six public records. Treasury tooling scores point seven zero, from ninety-four posts by fifty-eight authors. But only two demand sources. So AutoNEAR flags it: low confidence. It tells you when not to trust it.
scenes.display: Live snapshot: 306 public records. Treasury tooling scores 0.70, from 94 posts by 58 authors. But only 2 demand sources. So AutoNEAR flags it: low confidence. It tells you when not to trust it.

scenes.spoken: Seven roles turn evidence into a brief. Code limits their tools and the run budget. Citations must point to evidence they were given. Suspected injection text is withheld from model prompts.
scenes.display: 7 roles turn evidence into a brief. Code limits their tools and the run budget. Citations must point to evidence they were given. Suspected injection text is withheld from model prompts.

scenes.spoken: Now the human gate. Wrong nonce: rejected. Changed payload: rejected. No named signer: rejected. Kill switch on: rejected. Only the exact confirmation phrase gets through.
scenes.display: Now the human gate. Wrong nonce: rejected. Changed payload: rejected. No named signer: rejected. Kill switch on: rejected. Only the exact confirmation phrase gets through.

scenes.spoken: Approval is not execution. You sign in your own wallet. AutoNEAR records a deployment only after the chain checks out: signer, account, and code hash. Wrong hash? Refused. Mocked RPC in this recording.
scenes.display: Approval is not execution. You sign in your own wallet. AutoNEAR records a deployment only after the chain checks out: signer, account, and code hash. Wrong hash? Refused. Mocked RPC in this recording.

scenes.spoken: Underneath: registries in Rust for NEAR and Solidity for EVM. eighty-four and one hundred and forty-four passing tests, with fuzzing and invariants. They record approvals. They don't move funds.
scenes.display: Underneath: registries in Rust for NEAR and Solidity for EVM. 84 and 144 passing tests, with fuzzing and invariants. They record approvals. They don't move funds.

scenes.spoken: AutoNEAR. Evidence in. Human approves. Chain verifies. Clone it, run the tests, and tell us which approval rule you would add.
scenes.display: AutoNEAR. Evidence in. Human approves. Chain verifies. Clone it, run the tests, and tell us which approval rule you would add.
